title: CSSA Certification Practice Test
description: Comprehensive practice test for PEGA Certified Senior System Architect exam. 80 questions covering advanced topics.

questions.question: What is the best practice for optimizing PEGA application performance?
options: Minimize database calls and use declarative rules
questions.explanation: Minimizing database calls and using declarative rules improves performance by reducing I/O operations and leveraging PEGA's optimization engine.

questions.question: Which integration pattern is recommended for real-time data synchronization?
questions.explanation: REST API with webhooks provides real-time data synchronization, allowing systems to communicate immediately when events occur.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the PAL (PEGA Alerting and Logging) tool?
options: To monitor and alert on performance issues
questions.explanation: PAL is used to monitor application performance and alert administrators when thresholds are exceeded or issues occur.

questions.question: What is circumstancing in PEGA?
options: A way to create rule variants based on conditions
questions.explanation: Circumstancing allows creation of rule variants that apply under specific conditions, enabling customization without duplication.

questions.question: Which tool is used for analyzing database performance in PEGA?
questions.explanation: All three tools can be used: Tracer for general execution flow, Database Trace for SQL analysis, and Performance Profiler for detailed metrics.

questions.question: What is the recommended approach for error handling in PEGA?
options: Use flow exception handling with error flows
Ignore errors and let the system handle them
questions.explanation: Flow exception handling with dedicated error flows provides structured, maintainable error management aligned with PEGA best practices.

questions.question: What is a Product Rule in PEGA?
options: A rule for calculating product prices
A packaging mechanism for deploying applications
questions.explanation: Product Rules are packaging mechanisms that define what gets deployed, including which rulesets and versions.

questions.question: Which of the following improves rule reusability?
questions.explanation: Circumstancing and parameterization allow the same rule to handle different scenarios, improving reusability and maintainability.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a Declare Index?
options: To optimize report performance by maintaining summary tables
questions.explanation: Declare Index optimizes report performance by automatically maintaining summary tables that aggregate data.

questions.question: What is the recommended way to handle long-running processes in PEGA?
options: Use background processing with agents or queue processors
questions.explanation: Background processing with agents or queue processors allows long-running tasks to execute without blocking users or consuming requestor resources.
